'''Carteri''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] operative of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. On [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] he was approached by [[Hunter (individual)|Hunter]] and [[Mako (slicer)|Mako]], who he mistook for her identical sister [[Coral (Human)|Coral]]. Believing that he was dealing with a dangerous criminal, Carteri knew better than to try and outdraw her and simply handed to Mako the encrypted datapad she asked him for.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Carteri appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an NPC on Nar Shaddaa, involved in Mako companion storyline.
